# Marshall Elliott

## Overview

- **Age:** About fifty years old.
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c9 P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c37 P0](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0000), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c9 P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Marshall Elliott is a tall, fine-looking man with broad shoulders, a Roman nose, and frank gray eyes. For fifteen years he wore a rivers of crinkly brown beard nearly to his knees and a cascade of thick, wavy brown hair down his back. After shaving his beard and cutting his hair, he appeared clean-shaven with a strong, handsome face, though looking somewhat like a Viking.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 c35 P32](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0032)_

## Personality

He is an intensely loyal, zealous Liberal in politics who is stubborn and determined enough to stick to a vow for fifteen years. Though possessing a strong temper, he is a witty, intelligent, and well-read man who is a talented singer and dancer. He is an outspoken, fine man who enjoys a good joke and possesses great physical strength.

_Sources: [v2 c9 P33](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0033), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P35](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0035), [v4 c16 P9](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0009), [v4 c16 P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 c35 P31](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0031), [v4 c37 P17](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0017)_

## Goals

- Refusing to shave or cut his hair until the Liberal party came into power  <sub>[v2 c9 P33](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0033), [v4 c9 P33](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0033)</sub>

## History

During a particularly bitter political campaign fifteen years before the Liberals came to power, Marshall Elliott vowed publicly at a meeting that he would not cut his hair or shave his beard until the Grit party was elected. Because the Liberals remained out of power for years, he grew an extraordinarily long beard and mane of hair, making him a well-known eccentric in the area. When the Liberals finally won a general election years later, he immediately went to the Glen St. Mary barber at midnight and had his hair cut and beard shaved off. Shortly afterwards, he married Miss Cornelia Bryant and moved to her farm to live.

_Sources: [v2 c9 P33](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0033), [v4 c9 P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 c9 P33](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0033), [v4 c35 P29](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0029), [v4 c35 P30](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0030), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P13](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0013)_
